从 ACT 的动作分块走向条件扩散，在 PushT 低维观测上追踪去噪步数、推理: Moving from ACT action chunks to conditional diffusion, studying denoising steps, inference latency and closed-loop scores on low-dimensional PushT observations.
已整理 PushT 训练、推理消融与行为案例: PushT training, inference ablations and behavior cases documented
VLA 学习路线第二周的研究记录，涵盖论文、低维 UNet、代码映射与本地 Pu: Week 2 research notes in a VLA learning roadmap, covering the paper, low-dimensional UNet, code map and local PushT experiments. Results cite existing logs and tables in the public repository from a small learning experiment.
ACT 留下了多模态动作与训练、推理潜变量差异的问题。条件扩散从高斯噪声逐步生成: ACT raised questions about multimodal actions and differences between training and inference latent variables. Conditional diffusion gradually generates action chunks from Gaussian noise; this study examines the separate effects of prediction windows and inference compute.
我梳理了观测条件、动作加噪、噪声预测和闭环执行的链路，并将其对应到工作区、策略、: I mapped observation conditioning, action noising, noise prediction and closed-loop execution to the workspace, policy, UNet and runner.
我整理了本地训练记录和新进程重载评估，区分噪声 MSE、闭环得分与 checkp: I organized local training records and checkpoint evaluation in a new process, distinguishing noise MSE, closed-loop scores and checkpoint selection.
我核对了固定 EMA 模型下的 DDIM 步数消融，并追踪 env 100003: I checked DDIM step ablations on a fixed EMA model and traced the failure case at environment seed 100003 and sampling seed 0.
两帧 20 维关键点观测展平为 40 维条件。CondUnet1D 对长度 16: Two 20-dimensional keypoint observations form a flattened 40-dimensional condition. CondUnet1D predicts noise for a length-16 sequence of 2-dimensional actions; inference starts from Gaussian noise and executes 8 aligned actions after K updates.
训练：seed = 42，100 epochs，batch = 32，训练噪声级: Training: seed 42, 100 epochs, batch 32, N = 100 training noise levels, EMA enabled. Evaluation loads ema_model from the final-epoch latest.ckpt.
消融固定模型、归一化与观测窗口；DDIM 使用 η = 0、leading 间隔: The ablation fixes the model, normalization and observation window; DDIM uses η = 0 and leading spacing. Each cell contains 5 environment initial states × 3 sampling seeds, with up to 300 steps per episode.
延迟为 RTX 4060 Laptop 上 batch-1、CUDA 同步的 p: Latency is the median CUDA-synchronized batch-1 predict_action time on an RTX 4060 Laptop, with 3 warmups and 20 measurements, excluding model loading, data transfer and environment simulation.
在该模型与评估面板上，DDIM-10 的得分为 0.987，相比 DDIM-10: On this model and evaluation panel, DDIM-10 scores 0.987 versus DDIM-100's 0.991, a decrease of 0.004. Median latency falls from 1116.1 ms to 116.2 ms, a 9.60× speedup.
固定模型推理消融 · 每格 15 个 rollout；得分为回合最高奖励的均值: Fixed-model inference ablation · 15 rollouts per cell; score is mean episode max reward
得分不是二值成功率。DDPM-100 是另一采样器的完整链参考，不进入 DDIM: Score is not a binary success rate. DDPM-100 is a full-chain reference from a different sampler and is excluded from the DDIM speedup denominator.
得分未随 K 单调变化：env 100003、采样种子 0 在 DDPM-100: Score does not vary monotonically with K: environment seed 100003 and sampling seed 0 scores just 0.179 under DDPM-100 and DDIM-20, versus 1.0 for the other three DDIM settings. High mean scores still need episode-level behavior checks.
结论限于一个模型、5 个环境初态与当前计时条件，K = 10 是这一面板上的候选: Conclusions are limited to one model, 5 environment initial states and the recorded timing conditions. K = 10 is a candidate tradeoff on this panel. Next steps include more initial states and training seeds, visual conditioning, and closed-loop control with actual compute delay.

VLA 学习路线第三周的研究记录：手写线性路径与 Euler，核对官方 API，: Week 3 research notes in a VLA learning roadmap: handwritten linear paths and Euler, official API checks, then solvers, goal conditioning, endpoint pairing and an image interface. Results come from local experiments documented in the repository.
Flow Matching 保留从噪声生成动作块的接口，将训练目标改为路径速度。: Flow Matching keeps the interface of generating action chunks from noise and changes the training target to path velocity. This study separately checks whether the network uses its condition, whether the ODE is integrated accurately, and whether samples approach the target distribution.
我梳理了线性插值、速度标签与采样 ODE，区分训练更新参数和推理更新样本。: I studied linear interpolation, velocity labels and the sampling ODE, distinguishing parameter updates in training from sample updates during inference.
我整理了同一 two-moons 模型的官方 API 核对与等 NFE 求解器比: I organized official API checks and equal-NFE solver comparisons on the same two-moons model, explaining RMSE and SWD2 separately.
我追踪了目标置换干预、双弯曲模式、独立配对与 minibatch OT，并核对图: I traced goal-permutation interventions, both bending modes, independent pairing and minibatch OT, and checked the scope of the image-conditioned action interface experiments.
线性路径 xτ = (1 − τ)x0 + τx1，以 x1 − x0 为速度回: The linear path xτ = (1 − τ)x0 + τx1 uses x1 − x0 as its velocity regression label. Inference receives only noise and conditions and integrates dX/dτ = vθ. The two-moons model is an MLP; the synthetic action model also receives goal coordinates.
two-moons：seed = 42，5000 次 Adam 更新、batch: Two-moons: seed 42, 5000 Adam updates, batch 256, and a three-layer SiLU MLP of width 128. Handwritten Euler and flow_matching 1.0.10 have maximum output difference 0 on the same grid.
求解器比较固定该模型，3 个评估种子、每种子 1024 点；NFE 统计速度网络: Solver comparisons fix this model and use 3 evaluation seeds with 1024 points per seed. NFE counts whole-batch velocity-network forwards. RMSE compares against float64 Dopri5 for the same field; SWD2 uses 64 projection directions.
在 NFE = 24 时，Heun3 的端点 RMSE 为 0.000338，E: At NFE = 24, Heun3 has endpoint RMSE 0.000338 versus Euler's 0.030299; their SWD2 values are 0.065768 and 0.072698. More accurately integrating the current velocity field and improving the generated distribution are distinct questions.
固定 two-moons 模型 · 等 NFE = 24；指标为 3 个评估种子: Fixed two-moons model · equal NFE = 24; metrics averaged over 3 evaluation seeds
独立训练的合成动作模型生成 16 个二维位移。Midpoint 的 NFE =: A separately trained synthetic action model generates 16 two-dimensional displacements. Midpoint uses NFE = 64; goal error is 0.0364 over 3 sampling seeds with 512 samples each. After goal permutation, error is 0.0362 against the supplied new goal and 0.8068 against the original goal, supporting that outputs follow the input condition.
另一个三训练种子配对实验中，NFE = 4 的 SWD2 为独立 CFM 0.1: In a separate pairing experiment with 3 training seeds, SWD2 at NFE = 4 is 0.187 ± 0.021 for independent CFM and 0.062 ± 0.004 for OT-CFM. Mean training time is about 1.82× as long as independent CFM; ± denotes standard deviation across seeds.
two-moons 与合成动作结果不等同于机器人性能。图像 PushT 补充只验: Two-moons and synthetic action results do not establish robot performance. The image-based PushT supplement checks an interface, overfitting on two windows, and three rollouts with official weights. Next steps require diffusion comparisons on the same task and observations, plus pairing studies that preserve observation–action correspondence.

这是 VLA 学习路线第一周的研究记录，围绕 Action Chunking w: A Week 1 research record in a VLA learning roadmap, covering the ACT paper, model architecture, code map and simulation experiments. The public repository consolidates existing evaluation logs and CSV files; the results below come from those records, with no new training performed while compiling the notes.
逐步预测单个动作的行为克隆容易在长时序操作中累积误差。ACT 一次预测一段动作，: Single-step behavior cloning can accumulate errors over long manipulation sequences. ACT predicts a chunk of actions and can combine overlapping predictions through temporal aggregation. This project examines how chunk length affects bimanual transfer, what temporal aggregation improves, and which failures average success rates can hide.
梳理行为克隆、动作分块、CVAE 与 DETR 风格 Transformer，并: Mapped behavior cloning, action chunking, the CVAE and the DETR-style Transformer to data loading, policy modules, losses and closed-loop evaluation.
在 MuJoCo + dm_control 的 sim_transfer_cub: Reproduced ACT on sim_transfer_cube_scripted in MuJoCo + dm_control, using 50 scripted demonstrations and an 80/20 training/validation split with a fixed split seed.
控制数据、模型和训练配置，对 k = 1、20、50、100 做动作块长度消融，: Ran a controlled chunk-size ablation with k = 1, 20, 50 and 100, keeping data, architecture and training settings fixed and comparing both aggregation modes on the same 50 initial evaluation poses.
追踪唯一未被时间聚合修复的 rollout 33，整理固定位置的 10 次复测与: Investigated rollout 33, the only failure remaining with temporal aggregation, using 10 fixed-pose replays and a nearby 7 × 7 pose grid to separate overall performance from spatial generalization weaknesses.
策略输入为 top 相机图像和 14 维关节状态，输出 k 个 14 维关节动作: The policy takes a top-camera image and a 14-dimensional joint state and predicts k joint actions, each with 14 dimensions. ResNet18 extracts visual features and a Transformer encoder–decoder predicts the action chunk. During training, a CVAE encodes demonstration actions into a latent variable; inference sets that latent variable to zero.
主实验：k = 100，batch size = 2（8 GB 显存限制），hi: Main run: k = 100, batch size = 2 (limited by 8 GB VRAM), hidden dimension = 512, feedforward dimension = 3200, KL weight = 10, learning rate = 1e-5, 2000 epochs and training seed = 0.
每回合 400 步，控制间隔 0.02 s；k = 100 对应 2 s 预测窗: Each episode has 400 steps at 0.02 s intervals; k = 100 gives a 2 s prediction horizon. Without aggregation, the entire chunk is executed. With temporal aggregation, the policy replans every 20 ms and exponentially averages overlapping action predictions.
按最低验证损失选择 checkpoint，评估种子固定为 1000；最高奖励达到: The checkpoint is selected by minimum validation loss, with evaluation seed fixed at 1000. An episode succeeds when its highest reward reaches 4. The table reports task success rates on the same 50 initial poses.
主实验 k = 100 时，时间聚合将成功率从 42/50（84%）提高到 49: At k = 100, temporal aggregation raised success from 42/50 (84%) to 49/50 (98%), a gain of 14 percentage points, while average return increased from 555.24 to 604.76. In this setup, success without aggregation increased with chunk length.
动作块长度消融 · 每种设置评估 50 个相同初始位姿: Chunk-size ablation · the same 50 initial poses per setting
失败分析：rollout 33 位于训练采样范围的左下边界附近，固定该位置复测为: Failure analysis: rollout 33 lies near the lower-left boundary of the training sampling range. Fixed-pose replays yielded 0/10 successes. Of 49 nearby grid points, 34 fully succeeded, 6 partially completed the task and 9 received zero reward; the separate replay of the original failed pose is excluded from these 49 points.
关键认识：时间上的鲁棒性不等于空间泛化；k = 1 即使验证损失较低，闭环成功率: Key finding: temporal robustness does not imply spatial generalization. At k = 1, low validation loss still coincided with 0% closed-loop success. Task success, state-space coverage and failure trajectories must therefore be examined together.
结果限于单个仿真任务与当前训练、评估种子，未验证真实机器人、人类示范数据或插入任: These results are limited to one simulated task and the current training and evaluation seeds; real robots, human demonstrations and insertion were not tested. The weak region is inside the training sampling range, so it is not a strict out-of-distribution failure. Next steps include multiple seeds, denser pose sweeps and comparisons with Diffusion Policy for action generation and spatial coverage.
面向 2026 电赛 H 题，在 K230 上实现钢球检测、标定位置串口输出，以: A K230 vision project for the 2026 Electronic Design Contest, Problem H, with steel-ball detection, calibrated position output over UART, wireless browser streaming and test recording.
面向车载平衡滚球运动控制系统，项目在 CanMV K230 上实现两套可独立运行: For a vehicle-mounted ball-balancing control system, this project provides two independently runnable vision programs on CanMV K230: one detects the steel ball and sends its position to an external controller; the other streams camera images with detection overlays to a browser over Wi-Fi for observation and debugging.
控制端需要可解释的钢球位置反馈，调试时也需要看到摄像头画面和识别状态。因此系统同: The controller needs interpretable ball-position feedback, while debugging requires visibility into camera images and detection status. The implementation connects object detection, mechanical-center and direction calibration, a UART data interface and LAN streaming without a dedicated client.
钢球识别：通过 YOLOv8 的 K230 模型检测钢球，计算中心坐标、置信度和: Steel-ball detection: use a YOLOv8 model deployed on K230 to compute the ball center, confidence and signed position, then transmit the results through UART1.
位置标定：用 center.cfg、PLUS.cfg 和 Minus.cfg 保: Position calibration: store the mechanical center and positive/negative reference positions in center.cfg, PLUS.cfg and Minus.cfg for position conversion.
无线图传：提供带检测结果叠加的 MJPEG 浏览器画面、H.264 测试录像和录: Wireless streaming: provide browser MJPEG video with detection overlays, H.264 test recording and a recording control page, with automatic startup and retry after the streaming program exits with an exception.
采集与联调：提供钢球和标定图像采集脚本、ball / zero / limit: Data collection and integration: provide scripts for ball and calibration images, raw ball / zero / limit image collection with a manifest.csv, and a separate UART2 fixed-coordinate transmission test.
硬件与运行环境为 CanMV K230、MicroPython 固件 v1.8、: The setup uses CanMV K230, MicroPython firmware v1.8, an OV5647 camera and an 800 × 480 ST7701 LCD; an optional TI MSPM0 controller receives UART data. Detection and wireless streaming both use the camera and display, so one entry point is selected for the current task.
识别入口 steel_ball_best.py：加载 best.kmodel 和: Detection entry point steel_ball_best.py loads best.kmodel and the three calibration files, displays the results and sends data over UART1 at 115200 baud, 8N1.
成功检测时发送 BALL,cx,cy,confidence 与 POS,sign: Successful detection sends BALL,cx,cy,confidence and POS,signed_position_cm. A missing target sends BALL,-1,-1,0 and POS,NA, allowing the receiver to distinguish valid positions from missing detections.
图传入口 mjpeg_steel_ball_server.py：连接 Wi-Fi: Streaming entry point mjpeg_steel_ball_server.py connects to Wi-Fi, uses a matching steel_ball.kmodel and serves video on port 8080 of the device IP. The /control page manages recordings saved in /data/Video on the device.
公开仓库已提供识别、图传、数据采集与串口测试脚本，以及 best.kmodel: The public repository includes detection, streaming, data collection and UART test scripts, plus best.kmodel and position-calibration files. The delivered software connects image capture and model inference to position output and browser-based debugging. Detection accuracy, end-to-end latency, frame rate and long-run stability still require measurements under defined test conditions.
脚本依赖 CanMV 固件，不能直接在普通 CPython 环境运行。模型输入尺: The scripts depend on CanMV firmware and do not run directly in standard CPython. Model input dimensions and class order must match the scripts; streaming and detection also use different model paths. Mechanical changes require recalibration. Next steps are to measure position error, communication latency and recovery from lost detections, and add a hardware demonstration.

在 Ascend 上分析 Online Softmax 的累计状态，设计影响量检: Analyzing Online Softmax state on Ascend, designing impact-based checks, and validating fault tolerance through injection tests and logZ comparison.

围绕 FlashAttention 中 Online Softmax 的累计分母: This project studies how errors propagate through the running denominator l in FlashAttention’s Online Softmax, designs sampled checks, and documents correctness, fault injection, bit sensitivity, and performance tests. The two reports cover multi-precision functional testing and key-variable analysis with validation restricted to FP32.
Online Softmax 按 tile 更新最大值 m 与累计分母 l。重缩: Online Softmax updates the maximum m and running denominator l tile by tile. Errors in the rescaling factor α can be amplified by accumulated history, while existing state errors may propagate across tiles. Lazy-max also permits different (m, l) pairs to represent the same normalization state, so comparing raw max / sum can produce false failures.
从 l 的递推公式做一阶扰动分析，区分当前 tile 增量 p_rowsum、历: Use first-order perturbation analysis of the l recurrence to separate the effects of the current tile contribution p_rowsum, historical rescaling factor α, and accumulated state l_old.
以 αImpact 衡量重缩放误差对 l 的实际影响，结合分母残差检测；通过独立: Measure the effect of rescaling errors on l with αImpact and combine it with a denominator residual check. Independently compute the expected maximum and α to reduce the risk of common-mode errors in computation and detection.
整理故障注入后的 shadow state 恢复、fault flag 读改写、: Document shadow-state restoration after injection, read-modify-write fault flags, sampling keys, and eligible-sample accounting; validate bit-23 injection and bit sensitivity for three intermediate quantities.
使用 canonical logZ 比较 Softmax 状态，修正 lazy-: Compare Softmax states using canonical logZ to correct false failures caused by lazy-max representations, and distinguish numerical changes from the incremental performance cost of enabling fault checks.
核心递推为 l_new = α × l_old + p_rowsum，其中 α: The recurrence is l_new = α × l_old + p_rowsum, where α = exp(m_old − m_new). Its first-order perturbation is Δl_new ≈ l_old × Δα + α × Δl_old + Δp_rowsum, separating historical rescaling, state propagation across tiles, and the current tile contribution.
检测量 αImpact = |α − α_expected| × |l_old|: The check αImpact = |α − α_expected| × |l_old| measures the effect on the denominator. In the first tile, l_old = 0, so α does not affect its update and that sample is excluded from α detection. The residual l_residual = |l_new − l_expected| checks recurrence consistency.
对于 lazy-max，使用 logZ = m + log(l) 比较等价的归一: For lazy-max, logZ = m + log(l) compares equivalent normalization states. Attention outputs are still compared element by element, while raw max / sum remain diagnostic values. No kernel ABI change is required.
2026 年 7 月 22 日的功能测试环境：Ascend 910、CANN 9: The July 22, 2026 functional tests used Ascend 910, CANN 9.0.0, normally distributed inputs, and seed = 42. Coverage included FP32 / FP16 / BF16; S = 1024 / 2048 / 4096; B = 1, N = 64, and D = 128.
两份报告的检测范围不同：7 月 22 日报告在 S > 1024 时测试三种精度: The reports use different detection scopes. The July 22 report tests all three precisions when S > 1024. The key-variable analysis report enables sampled checks only for FP32 with S > 1024. FP16 / BF16 keep their computation outputs but have detection disabled because of false positives across runs, overhead, and unstable thresholds.
7 月 22 日的故障注入设置为 FT_FAULT_INJECT = 4、bit: The July 22 injection setting was FT_FAULT_INJECT = 4, bit = 23. S = 1024 skips direct Softmax checking; S = 2048 / 4096 tests inspect sampling markers, fault flags, and attention outputs.
关键量分析报告中，使用 logZ 修正比较口径后，正确性测试从 14/18 提升: In the key-variable analysis report, correcting the comparison with logZ improved correctness test passes from 14/18 to 18/18. The formal fault-injection suite passed 9/9 and unit tests passed 5/5. No false positives were observed in the tested fault-free FP32 cases.
Bit-23 三量注入 · FP32，仅统计符合检测条件的样本: Bit-23 injection into three quantities · FP32, eligible samples only
位敏感度：α 的 bit0–4 低于影响阈值，bit5–31 的有效样本全部检出: Bit sensitivity: α bits 0–4 were below the impact threshold, while every eligible sample for bits 5–31 was detected, extending low-bit coverage from the previous onset around bit 13. For p_rowsum, bits 0–12 stayed below threshold, bit 13 was partially detected, bit 14 was nearly fully detected, and bits 15–31 reached approximately 100%. For l_old, bits 0–12 were partially detected, bit 14 was nearly fully detected, and bits 15–31 reached or approached 100%.
7 月 22 日的注入矩阵包含 6 个 S > 1024 正向案例和 3 个 S: The July 22 injection matrix comprised six positive cases with S > 1024 and three negative cases with S = 1024, passing 9/9. All positive cases detected injection and set bit_or = 0x4; negative cases performed no injection and produced no false positives.
容错开关对比：7 月 22 日的 FP32、S = 2048 / 4096 测试: Comparing the fault-check switch: in the July 22 FP32 tests at S = 2048 / 4096, bmm_only and full produced elementwise-identical attentionOut, softmaxMax, and softmaxSum. The custom / system auxiliary-output differences occurred in both modes, so that report rated full API consistency as Conditional Pass.
7 月 22 日报告 · Softmax 增量开销 = full / bmm_o: July 22 report · Incremental Softmax overhead = full / bmm_only − 1
测量采用 5 次预热、30 次计时、3 轮重复取中位数。以上 6 组启用检测的测: Measurement used five warmups, 30 timed iterations, and the median across three repeated rounds. Across these six test points with checks enabled, median incremental overhead was about 3.34% and the arithmetic mean was about 3.76%. The baseline was bmm_only, not the system operator.
FP32 / 4096 的负增量不作为加速结论。BF16 / 4096 首次出现: The negative FP32 / 4096 value is not treated as a speedup claim. The first BF16 / 4096 run contained an outlier exceeding 180 seconds; the table uses the median from three independent reruns. S = 1024 had no checks enabled, so its timing differences are excluded from the aggregate. These measurements apply only to the July 22 test configuration.
当前关键量检测结论限定于 FP32、S > 1024 和报告中的抽样及注入条件，: The key-variable detection findings are limited to FP32 with S > 1024 and the reported sampling and injection conditions; they do not establish detection of arbitrary faults. Next steps are to stabilize low-precision thresholds and behavior across runs, measure the revised detector’s performance, and distinguish canonical state equivalence from full API auxiliary-output consistency.
